csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using System.Text; public class MovementBlockAnalysis { public static string Execute() { GameObject player = GameObject.Find("Player_Test01"); if (player == null) return "Player_Test01 not found."; StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.AppendLine($"--- Block Analysis for {player.name} ---"); var rb = player.GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); if (rb != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] isKinematic: {rb.isKinematic}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] constraints: {rb.constraints}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] linearDamping: {rb.linearDamping}"); } var joint = player.GetComponent<ConfigurableJoint>(); if (joint != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[Joint] Found ConfigurableJoint!"); sb.AppendLine($"[Joint] xMotion: {joint.xMotion}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Joint] yMotion: {joint.yMotion}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Joint] zMotion: {joint.zMotion}"); } var colliders = player.GetComponents<Collider>(); sb.AppendLine($"[Colliders] Count: {colliders.Length}"); foreach(var col in colliders) { sb.AppendLine($" - {col.GetType().Name} (IsTrigger: {col.isTrigger})"); } return sb.ToString(); } }
